given: a SKU's par level is not tracked
when: a warehouse operator opens the detail view for that SKU
then: the par level shows an explicit "not tracked" indication instead of a blank region or a null-related crash
architectural_notes: E2E: exercises the untracked optional-field presentation path in the SPA detail view (client/). The par level is a nullable persisted column on stock_records; the repository (app/repositories/) reads it, the service (app/services/) passes the null/absent value through, the boundary (app/routes/) returns it as JSON (null/omitted), and the client presentation layer is responsible for rendering an explicit 'not tracked' indicator rather than a blank region or null crash (PO preference, NFR-F1-8). The null-safe rendering is a client presentation concern, NOT domain logic. Verified by a SPA component test on the untracked path plus the R4 branch integration test confirming the boundary returns the record with the optional field absent.

independence.rationale: AC1 and AC2 cover tracked data present on the record (locations, quantities, tracking code); AC3 covers the untracked optional par-level path, which can be broken (blank region or null crash) while the populated fields still render, and vice versa
